title: Solar-farm onset (day-only repeats)
asserts: an unmapped solar farm seen only by day (one pixel on day 1, two on day 2, all within one site) is quarantined as suspected_static_source on the third detection, and a watching zone is never alerted — suppressed as invalidated, never sent; without the policy pinned the same polls defer a new_fire and put the farm in the 09:00 digest, so the quarantine is what keeps it silent
